verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a built-in AI assistant is Worldsmith, which builds simulated worlds from a user's natural-language description. That is a narrow form of delegation limited to environment construction. The llms.txt also mentions autonomous fix and rollback for production agents, but gives no detail on how a user delegates tasks to it. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks across the platform, documentation of Worldsmith's interaction model and scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Worldsmith builds that world from your description, from a single service to a workflow across connected tools.
Real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback.
